description: Run wolfSSL/fenrir Skoll CLI against the PKIX workspace for automated security review, RFC conformance checking, bug hunting, and code quality analysis. Skoll uses Claude CLI under the hood with battle-tested prompt templates from the fenrir project. PKIX is an RFC 5280 X.509 path validation workspace — the rfc, security, and consttime scan types are the highest-signal modes. Since PKIX is not a wolfSSL ecosystem project, Skoll will use adaptive auto-detection to build an ephemeral scan config from repo evidence (tracked files, README, build signals, language mix, domain keywords like x509/pkix/rfc5280/der/asn1). Each scan produces both JSON (/tmp/skoll-review-*.json) and Markdown (/tmp/skoll-review-*.md) output. After all scans complete, triage the findings: deduplicate across scan modes, assess severity, dismiss false positives, and file fix beads for real issues.
title: Skoll security audit of PKIX workspace
